name: Aesrias's mother
description: A warrior who fell at the third battle of the Pharagax Bridge after slaying seven, whose sacrifice led Iroas to bless Aesrias.

timeline.summary: Aesrias meets the star-skinned nyxborn in the next cell, who knew his mother.
timeline.quote: I've heard your name and I know your mother.
